description: Search Bot Shelf, 9,000+ ready-made community Grok Bots shared on X, by the job in plain words, for example "manage my X bookmarks", "summarise my school emails" or "track my invoices". Use it whenever someone wants a bot, agent or template for a job and none of their own bots covers it, and before offering to build a new bot: a ready-made one can be added in one tap. Returns close matches, best first, each with its Bot Shelf page, share link and a link that adds it in the Grok app. Credit the creator when you recommend one.
